maya: Quick note for month-end  we need to accrue for a pricing experiment refund issued to a mid-market customer (DeltaWare) for $6,750. It was issued as a credit memo after June close.
tom: Is this credit memo applied to AR or refunded?
maya: Applied to AR. No cash movement.
sarah: Under ASC 606 this reduces revenue in the period of performance. Since memo is post-close, recommended to book a prior-period adjustment in the June schedule and record reversing entries in July for transparency.
tom: Proposed JE recorded in June (to align revenue):
```
Date: 2024-06-30
Dr. 4000 - Hosted API Revenue               6,750
   Cr. 1200 - Accounts Receivable (credit memo) 6,750
Narrative: Reverse recognized revenue for DeltaWare pricing experiment credit memo (credit memo CM-5453).
```
maya: If audit prefers not to restate, we will instead post a July accrual and disclose as prior-period correction in the close memo.
acct-bot: Reminder: attach CM PDF and contract DW-2022-11 to the JE. Cutoff for EOY adjustments is 17:00 local.
sarah: I'll draft a 1-page memo for the audit folder explaining the experiment, contract terms, and why Option A (retroactive reduction) is chosen. Tag memo 'rev-rec-pricing-experiment' and cc tax.
maya: Thanks. Tom, please prepare JE and upload before cutoff. We'll loop in legal if contract wording is ambiguous.
